articles.title: Battlefield 6 Reportedly Cancels Mass Effect Collab In Wake Of BioWare Closure
articles.summary: Battlefield Studios is reportedly cancelling plans for a Mass Effect collaboration in Battlefield 6 in the wake of EA's decision to close BioWare and cancel the next game in the sci-fi series.
body: Fans discovered various Mass Effect-themed cosmetics in Battlefield 6's files, with many speculating that they would be released in November, tied to the Mass Effect N7 Day holiday on November 7.
Those cosmetics, which included Mass Effect-themed weapon charms and patches, have seemingly now been removed from Battlefield 6's in-game store prior to their general availability ( via Kotaku ).

If these Mass Effect-themed cosmetics were indeed real, getting yanked only makes sense, considering the blowback EA and Battlefield Studios would have faced for hawking new items based on a franchise that it just killed off.
While this Mass Effect collab might not be going ahead, Battlefield 6 is currently hosting a crossover event with Dead Space.

articles.title: Finger Out How To Prep For GTA 6 With These Exercises
articles.summary: We're just weeks away from Grand Theft Auto VI launching, and you might think you're set to spend hours upon hours in the open-world game right now. But PureGym asks if your body is actually ready like former Nintendo of America president Reggie Fils-Aime's --as well as your thumbs.
body: With that in mind, the fitness company has shared three thumb workouts from personal trainer David Hope to help prep you for GTA VI. These exercises are meant as a warm-up before picking up your controller, by the way. The first is just tapping your thumb with each finger on the same hand, which as a personal aside, can be a good mindfulness technique, too.

The next finger drill sees you spreading your hand out and making a five, then turning that into a fist with your thumb on the outside. Our added suggestion is to do spirit fingers between fists to look as ridiculous as possible. Last but not least, Hope recommends finger pushups, where you "press the fingertips of both hands on the floor and push pressure into your fingers," according to the press release.

PureGym advises people to do these exercises 10 times each, as well as after a long session with GTA VI. "We warm up before a run or a gym session, so why not before a long gaming session? Your thumbs and hands are doing the heavy lifting, and the rest of your body is barely moving," Hope said.

articles.title: Save Mass Effect Petition Hits 50,000 Signatures, Just Days After BioWare Closure
articles.summary: EA shut down BioWare on Wednesday, cancelling its upcoming Mass Effect game. And, after the trailer for what's now known as Mass Effect Universe leaked online, fans have started flocking to a petition in the hopes of saving the franchise.
body: The petition, #SaveMassEffect, was started on the same day as BioWare's closure, and has hit 52,783 signatures at the time of writing, surpassing the original goal of 30,000. Rather than asking EA to reinstate BioWare, the petition demands that EA either puts another studio in charge of the franchise and funds the next Mass Effect game's development, or license out the IP so it can live on.

The petition's author, Joe Smith, made the case for saving Mass Effect: "Mass Effect holds a special place in the hearts of millions of players worldwide. Its rich and immersive sci-fi universe, with Commander Shepard leading the iconic crew aboard the Normandy, has captivated gamers for years. However, recent revelations have cast a shadow over its future. The decline in dedicated resources and ambiguous development plans from Electronic Arts (EA) threaten to leave this beloved series at a standstill, jeopardizing its incredible legacy."

Unfortunately, these kinds of petitions normally fail to spark corporate U-turns. And while a former BioWare executive has suggested EA might be more likely to sell the BioWare IP after the studio's closure, analysts disagree.

articles.summary: It might be the end of the road for Marvel's Blade developer Arkane Lyon, as a new report says that the studio has until November 13 to find a buyer or face closure. Le Monde reported that while Microsoft had followed the procedure as laid out in Florange Law--French legislation that requires…
body: According to IGN, development on Marvel's Blade was still on track for a new reveal in early 2027, followed by a Q4 2027 release. The game was originally revealed in December 2023, but aside from a handful of concept art images since then, nothing else has been shown.

If Arkane Lyon is facing closure, it'll be the end of a studio that has been around for 27 years. Its first game was Arx Fatalis in 2002, and it followed that up with the release of Dark Messiah of Might and Magic (2006) and KarmaStar (2009). Since the 2010s, the studio has pumped out several hits like the Dishonored games and Deathloop. The Texas-based studio that it operated, Arkane Austin, was established in 2006, but following the release of the critically panned Redfall in 2023, it was shut down in 2024.

Arkane Lyon's departure from the Xbox Games Studio portfolio was announced earlier this year, alongside Double Fine Productions, Compulsion Games, Undead Labs, and Ninja Theory. Most of the studios have opted to become independent developers again, but Ninja Theory is now expected to shut down as plans for outside investors to acquire it fell through.

articles.title: GTA 6 Burgers Will Be Available In Florida Throughout The Year
articles.summary: Rockstar Games and the burger company Skinny Louie have announced a partnership to promote GTA 6, during which its stores will convert to Burger Shots through the end of the year. Burger Shot is the Burger King parody in the world of GTA.
body: People in South Florida can buy GTA 6 burgers at the Kaseya Center, and also every Skinny Louie location in Florida starting in early November. The campaign runs through December 31.

The Burger Shot locations will serve a menu "straight out of Vice City"--and this includes smash burgers, fries, and drinks. People in South Florida can buy the GTA 6 burgers in store or have them delivered.

In addition to Burger Shot, GTA's Cluckin' Bell fried chicken store is available IRL at the Kaseya Center. It's unknown if the Cluckin' Bell locations will be available outside the arena like the Burger Shots are.

GTA 6's takeover of Miami also includes marketing efforts at local beaches and hotels. Some local lawmakers are pushing back, saying in that in agreeing to take Rockstar's money, the city is signing on to "depicting Miami like a murder capital." Other local lawmakers say it's just a video game.

articles.title: Canadian Politician Wants the Government to Bail Out Mass Effect Developer BioWare
articles.summary: Avi Lewis, leader of one of Canada's top opposition parties, wants the Canadian government to save Mass Effect developer BioWare. The leader of the New Democratic Party took to social media to speak out against publisher EA.
body: On October 21, EA announced a major shift in strategy and a significant internal restructuring that involves the cancellation of a number of projects, the closure of BioWare in Edmonton, and a reported 400 people losing their jobs. The studio, known for franchises like Mass Effect and Dragon Age, was shut down after more than 30 years of creating beloved role-playing games. It reportedly had 50 people working on the next Mass Effect, all of which were cut.

Lewis linked BioWare's closure to the $55 billion EA acquisition by an investor group composed of Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, Silver Lake, and Affinity Partners, approved in December 2025. Since the acquisition, EA has been focusing only on its biggest brands — Battlefield and its sports titles, predominantly — while other series have been pushed aside.
"This is private equity, this is what it does. Buy up businesses, run them into the ground, and rip them apart for short-term profit," Lewis wrote on X / Twitter.
points: Avi Lewis, leader of one of Canada's top opposition parties, wants the Canadian government to save Mass Effect developer BioWare.

articles.title: Plan to Save BioWare and Mass Effect Proposed by Canadian Politician
articles.summary: The game industry is still reeling from the announcement that EA and its new private equity investors shut down the legendary BioWare. The studio was one of the medium's most renowned developers, known for Mass Effect, Dragon Age, Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic, Jade Empire, and more.
body: While Mass Effect may be dead, a Canadian politician has an idea to bring back the Edmonton-based studio. "This is private equity, this is what it does. Buy up businesses, run them into the ground, and rip them apart for short-term profit," Avi Lewis, the leader of Canada’s New Democratic Party (NDP), wrote on X in response to the news.

"The developers at BioWare know how to run the studio. They know how to make the games we all love. They should be given the first opportunity - and the federal support - to buy it and run it themselves. And if we want to avoid the Mass Effect effect in Canada, we should be keeping private equity out, not welcoming it in."

From his comment, Lewis seems to support the Canadian government helping BioWare employees purchase the studio back from EA, returning the company to independence for the first time in almost 20 years. Although Lewis’ party doesn’t have enough seats in the House of Commons to make this happen unilaterally, it will be interesting to see if his remarks go anywhere.

articles.title: "Why the f**k would they add a perk like that?" - Modern Warfare 4 DMZ players are up in arms over the ability to self-revive
articles.summary: Modern Warfare 4's DMZ extraction shooter mode has only been out for two days - and only for those who pre-ordered the game - but already players are up in arms over a particular trait that allows competitors to revive themselves after being killed.
body: That trait is called Possum, and is one of the many abilities players can unlock as they level up their operators. How it works is this: if the trait is active, you're given the option, once per match, to revive yourself on command when killed. Doing so places you in a Last Stand state, and you'll need to pick yourself up from this vulnerable downed position to continue playing. All together, getting back into the firefight from dead takes around 10 uninterrupted seconds. You also lose any loot you've gathered when you revive - so you're back to square one.

It goes without saying that the ability to come back to life at all in an extraction shooter is a bold addition to DMZ. There doesn't seem to be a great way to see if a dead opponent has it, meaning every player you kill could come back for revenge later in the match when your guard is down. It doesn't take long to unlock either! If you focus your operator progression solely on the Warfighter path, Possum can be unlocked in a handful of hours. As such, it's likely someone in a DMZ match will be ready to pounce. And to say Possum is proving divisive among Call of Duty players would be an understatement.

articles.title: Every Sport in Nintendo Switch Sports Resort, Ranked From Worst to Best
articles.summary: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort is out now, and it features a wealth of content to dig into. It features 12 main sports, and many of them come with different modes. Combine that with a smart approach to a single-player “campaign” and some lovely open-island exploration, and you’ve got the series’…
body: I’ve been playing non-stop for the past week, and in that time, I’ve developed some strong opinions about which games rock and which ones don’t totally stick the landing. In the spirit of healthy competition, here’s where I would rank them, from worst to best. Let it be a guide for anyone who feels overwhelmed by all the options on offer and wants to stick to the classics. You won’t want to sleep on the less popular minigames. Trust me.

Generally speaking, the more involved a sport is, the harder it is to translate it to a motion-controlled minigame. Basketball is a shining example of that. It takes a game that’s built on motion and reduces it to a clumsy Simon Says, where you need to hit cues to shoot, block, and pass. Free-throwing is fine, but the standard multiplayer matches are just too complicated for their own good.

Everything I just said about Basketball also applies to Volleyball. It has all of the same problems, with its reliance on telegraphed maneuvers that break up the fluidity of a match. Volleyball works just a bit better since there’s not quite as much movement involved, but it comes off feeling like an inferior Tennis.

articles.title: Half-Life 3 is back in the news again as Valve developer accidentally sort-of references it in public, reigniting hope once more
articles.summary: It's been 19 years since the release of Half-Life 2: Episode 2, and yet the ceaseless clamour for a Valve game with a number '3' in its title continues. And following a swell of reports suggesting Half-Life 3 isn't just real, its development is well underway, a Valve developer has gone and sent the…
body: Valve's first attempt at releasing a Half-Life game with a '3' in its name would have been the ill-fated Half-Life 2: Episode 3, which was abandoned - despite Valve previously announcing it as part of a planned trilogy - sometime around 2009. After that, the studio seemingly had a crack at making a full-blown sequel, with Valve boss Gabe Newell confirming a few years back that Half-Life 3 had been in development around 2013/2014, but was ultimately scrapped because it was built on the unfinished Source 2 engine.

Sometime in 2021, however, dataminers began to notice something interesting: repeated references to a project codenamed "HLX" in Valve-related files. Inevitably, this led to a frenzy of speculation that Valve might finally be reviving its seminal, if long-dormant, first-person shooter franchise. And evidence has seemingly continued to amass over time. In 2024, for instance, Valve insider Tyler McVicker shared some of his datamined findings, claiming what he'd found pointed to a new "fully-fledged Half-Life game" - a claim coinciding with a leak from an actor likely involved in the project.

articles.title: Phantom Blade Zero isn't even out yet, but it could be 'one of the year's breakout hits' as it shifts half a million copies on Steam alone
articles.summary: Chinese action game Phantom Blade Zero already appears to be outperforming massive games like Gears of War: E-Day and Control Resonant on Steam, despite still being days from release.
body: That's according to sales data scrutinised by Alinea Analytics head of market analysis Rhys Elliott, who posted their findings on LinkedIn. Based on Elliott's estimates, Phantom Blade Zero has already sold 500,000 copies on Steam through pre-orders, bringing in roughly $24m in revenue ahead of its launch next week. Elliott noted the figures meant Phantom Blade Zero was "outperforming" Gears of War: E-Day and Control Resonant on Steam at the time of writing, and that China is currently its top market.

Other interesting tidbits include the fact that Phantom Blade Zero has also generated a lofty 2.5m Steam wishlists. According to Elliott, 41 percent of players who've wishlisted the game have also played Black Myth Wukong, while 38 percent of them have played Elden Ring and 28 percent played Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice.

It's an impressive start for Phantom Blade Zero on PC, and Elliott goes on to say that "pre-launch signals" point to the game being popular on PS5 too. He even goes as far as to suggest it has the "potential to be one of the year's breakout single-player hits."

videos.title: Grand Theft Auto V - The Legacy Review
videos.summary: Grand Theft Auto V legacy review by Luke Reilly. Reviewed on Xbox 360.
body: "Grand Theft Auto V was a game so preposterously future-proof upon its 2013 launch on Xbox 360 and PS3 that its subsequent ports to modern machines remain the benchmark for open-world action-driving games. At the conclusion of this GTA Legacy Review project I find myself too emotionally attached to the PS2 pair of Vice City and San Andreas to push past my adoration for the style and soundtracks of those period piece classics and place anything above them but, make no mistake, there are very few games I’ve played more than GTA V. Combining an enormous and extraordinarily detailed world, three compelling protagonists, a thrilling set of varied missions and heists, and the foundation for a world of multiplayer that is simply a whole separate discussion, GTA V is the peak of the series. At least for the next few weeks, that is."
points: Grand Theft Auto V legacy review by Luke Reilly.

videos.title: Cyberpunk 2077 - Broken Dreams: Edgerunners 2 Update Launch Trailer | PS5 Games
videos.summary: Seen the anime? Play the update — if you’re ready…
body: Dive back into Night City with the free Edgerunners 2 Update for Cyberpunk 2077, featuring content inspired by Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. Take on a new quest that takes place before the anime’s raw, brutal story begins; carry on Jackie’s legacy with the Dual Wielding playstyle; and discover much more as you pick up the pieces in the City of (Broken) Dreams.
The Edgerunners 2 Update is out now on PlayStation 5.
